response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates strong technical fundamentals, language proficiency across all required languages, and proven ability to architect systems at scale, he lacks critical domain expertise in experimentation platforms, metrics infrastructure, and experimental analysis—core competencies explicitly required for a Principal role in growth and experimentation systems. His extensive background shows no evidence of building telemetry foundations, experimentation frameworks, feature flighting systems, bias detection, or rollout risk management. For a Principal/IC6 position requiring deep specialized expertise, this represents a substantial gap that would require extended ramp-up time.
strengths: Exceptional technical breadth with mastery across all required languages (C, C++, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python) and experience spanning web, mobile, desktop, and embedded systems
Proven ability to architect and maintain systems at scale (millions of HTTP requests/second at Dunnhumby) with strong emphasis on performance optimization and software craftsmanship

Demonstrated technical leadership through staff roles, open source projects (GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts, Trial) used by others, and extensive mentoring/education (Web Internals workshop, Selenium course)
concerns: No demonstrated experience building experimentation platforms, metrics infrastructure, telemetry foundations, or experimental analysis workflows—core responsibilities of this role
Lacks track record in experimental quality, bias detection, rollout risk management, or guardrail systems for experiments—key preferred qualifications
No evidence of working on growth-focused engineering systems or translating business ambiguity into measurable experimentation outcomes at scale

key_factors.factor: Experimentation platform and metrics infrastructure expertise
Demonstrated scale and distributed systems experience
